overview_description.description: Scalex Africa is a fintech and Web3 infrastructure company focused on enabling crypto-to-fiat and fiat-to-crypto payments across Africa. The platform provides stablecoin payment infrastructure, liquidity solutions, APIs, wallet services, and global payment tools for both businesses and individuals.

product.name: APIs and SDKs
product.description: APIs and SDKs enable businesses to process crypto-fiat swaps, fund wallets with fiat currency, and withdraw funds directly to bank accounts.

product.name: Liquidity Pool
product.description: A platform for users to add liquidity to a pool of crypto assets, set rates, and earn profits from the pool's operations.

product.name: Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application that connects external wallets across multiple blockchains, enabling fiat funding and direct bank withdrawals.

product.name: Checkout
product.description: A service that allows buying and selling of USDT and USDC stablecoins with fiat, including direct fiat receipt in bank accounts across multiple blockchain networks.
